name: CM23_crystallised_knowledge
origins: user requirement 2026-10-21 (crystallised knowledge, never disobey true proof)
statement: A statement is only as strong as its evidence: refuted (counterexample shown) < conjecture < witnessed (an exhaustive small-value phase plus seeded random values; the hypotheses must hold on enough inputs and must not pin a variable to one value) < proved (accepted by the Lean kernel). An imported Lean statement is kept only when the kernel accepts our reading as the original proposition.
